ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ passes through the vertex $P$ of the rectangle $AOBP$, and the two sides $AO$, $BO$ of the rectangle are respectively on the x-axis and y-axis. If the area of the rectangle is $7$, what is the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since the area of rectangle $OAPB$ is 7\\
it follows that $\left|k\right|=7$\\
Given that the graph is in the second quadrant, it implies $ k=-7$\\
Therefore, the answer is: $k=\boxed{-7}$

method.method_draft: Use the inverse-proportion rectangle-area invariant. The image shows the hyperbola branch and vertex P in the second quadrant, with the rectangle formed between P and the coordinate axes. For any point on y=k/x, the unsigned area of the rectangle determined by that point and the axes equals |xy|=|k|. The text gives this rectangle's area as 7, so |k|=7. Since the graph shown is in quadrant II, x<0 and y>0 there, so xy<0 and hence k<0. Thus k=-7.
